title: Initial spring B deformation
description: Essential: Correctly calculates the initial compression of spring B using Hooke's law (k1*x1 = mg).

title: Final spring B extension
description: Important: Recognizes that when pulled to point b, the tension in spring B equals mg, requiring a specific extension (x2).

title: Height A rises
description: Important: Correctly sums the magnitudes of the initial compression and final extension to find the total vertical displacement of A.

title: Spring C elongation
description: Important: Correctly relates the horizontal displacement ab to the deformations of spring B to find the stretch in spring C.

title: Force equilibrium for k2
description: Essential: Applies vertical force equilibrium on A at the final state to relate mg, spring B force, and the vertical component from spring C.

title: Correct k2 calculation
description: Essential: Solves the equilibrium equation to find the correct numerical value for the spring constant k2.

title: Unit consistency
description: Optional: Maintains consistent units (meters, Newtons) throughout the calculation.

title: Sign error in deformations
description: Pitfall: Confuses compression and extension for spring B, or misassigns signs in the force balance.

title: Geometry misinterpretation
description: Pitfall: Incorrectly relates the horizontal distance ab to the vertical displacements of A or the stretch of spring C.
